newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain, German stock market watchdogs sign accord.
newsitem.headline: Spain, German stock market watchdogs sign accord.

text.p: Spain's stock market watchdog the CNMV said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement to improve cooperation and exchange information with its German counterpart the BAWe.
The deal, signed in Frankfurt, will improve communication between the two watchdogs and strengthen collaboration in meeting European directives, the CNMV said.

"The objective of the deal is to promote mutual assistance through the exchange of information... and prevent the use of confidential data, the manipulation of prices and any other type of fraudulent activity," the CNMV said.
The CNMV said it had also signed similar accords with the regulatory bodies in 14 other countries including France, Belgium, Portugal and Italy.
